scope: Bind the already-authored physical park-lamp installation into the authoritative benchmark save/capture path so source-side lamp construction cannot exist in the repository while the actual prepared scene silently retains the older stacked-cylinder lamp.

preflight.action: No runtime evidence existed, so source/data integration work was permitted.

finding.description: QualityBlockParkLampInstallationQA and its machine-readable construction/material contract existed, but QualityBlockParkFurnitureSaveGate did not call ApplyToOpenScene or ValidateOpenScene, and QualityBlockNative4KReviewPacket did not validate the installed lamp. The normal park rebuild therefore recreated PoleLower/PoleUpper/GroundMoistureBand/Neck/Cap before LOD rebind while the dedicated continuous tapered pole/service-cover/head assembly could remain orphaned from authoritative evidence preparation.
criticalDefectExposure: floating/interpenetrating hero geometry at head/service interfaces
materially impossible or stale lamp material state
visible LOD pop from unbound generated lamp renderers
missing required construction/material metadata enforcement in the actual prepared scene

changes.change: Require the dedicated lamp contract/lookdev, call ParkLampInstallationQA after PhysicalDiffuser creation and before LOD rebind, run shared microdetail, then fail closed on final lamp validation.
Require lamp contract configuration and revalidate the installed lamp before reflection capture, immediately before Camera.Render, and again before bound temporal evidence.

sourceVerification.parkLampDependency: PhysicalDiffuser is created by QualityBlockParkFurniturePhysicalRefinement before the lamp installation pass; QualityBlockParkLampInstallationQA intentionally preserves PhysicalDiffuser while replacing the other lamp construction parts.
sourceVerification.lodBinding: Lamp installation now precedes QualityBlockParkFurnitureLodRebind, so PhysicalPole, service gasket/cover, pole-top boot, adapter, retainers, cap and LOD0 fasteners are eligible for authoritative LOD membership validation.
sourceVerification.materialBinding: Final lamp validation runs after park microdetail, which is required because exposed service fasteners must reach the authoritative metallic state while concrete, paint, EPDM and diffuser remain dielectric.
sourceVerification.nativePacketReceipt: Installed-lamp validation is repeated pre-probe, pre-still and pre-temporal so later evidence phases cannot silently regress to the legacy assembly.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometryConstruction: Potentially prevents a major deduction by ensuring the continuous tapered pole and physical service/head interfaces are actually present in benchmark evidence.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.materialPbr: Potentially prevents stale material-state deductions by validating dielectric concrete/paint/EPDM/diffuser and metallic service fasteners after the authoritative microdetail pass.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.weathering: Potentially preserves cause-based flush grade moisture instead of the protruding legacy moisture ring.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporalLod: Potentially prevents unbound-renderer or legacy-assembly LOD discontinuity by applying the lamp before LOD rebind and revalidating before temporal evidence.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.rule: No category points are awarded until actual 3840x2160 frames, 100% crops and temporal evidence are inspected.

nextBlocker: No Unity runner, successful Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile, native 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing frames, 100% lamp crops or sealed temporal evidence are available. When runtime evidence appears, stop speculative expansion and inspect the actual lamp pixels first for pole continuity, grade contact, service-cover bearing, head insertion, Fresnel/material separation and LOD stability.
